name: grid/job-submit
description: Submit a forge job to a grid node's queue. The node executes when ready (GPU free). Returns a job ID for tracking. Replaces direct SSH forge execution.

params.name: nodeId
params.description: Target node to queue the job on

results.name: jobId
results.description: Unique job identifier for tracking and control

results.name: position
results.description: Position in the queue (0 = running now)

results.name: nodeId
results.description: Node the job was queued on

results.name: estimatedStart
results.description: Estimated start time (ISO 8601) based on queue depth

examples.description: Submit a reasoning forge to bigmama
